answer: At the autumn roundup every calf is branded and the brand entered in the herd book, and a reindeer without a registered brand may not join the migration. A meadow brand burned in a corral at night fails the book: at the beacon of the hide the iron must match the herder's own pattern, and a night brand is read as a thief's mark. Forging the brands means keeping reindeer for three calving seasons, branding 190 calves and paying 15,700, while the quartz entry in the herd book is read at every market, so a calf whose brand was never entered is taken from the herd.
